title.narrative: Strengthening capacities for effective reading-translating original Lao language (Phasa laodeum) in palm leave manuscript

description.narrative:
For the past three decades there has been cooperation between the government, international agencies, and communities which collaborated to recover, restore, and catalogue damaged manuscripts and register them on the list of inventories. The manuscripts were digitised and stored on websites like the National Library of Laos and Ministry of Information and Culture and Tourism, ensuring broad access. The inventory includes complete palm-leaf manuscript (PLM) lists and full texts accessible at https://digital.crossasia.org/digital-library-of-lao-manuscripts.
The primary challenge now is strengthening capacities for effective reading-writing and translating of the ancient Lao script, original Lao language (Phasa Laodeum,) in the palm leaf manuscripts to official Lao language, a pressing task requiring expertise.
